title: Head of Project Management Office – Heavy Machinery (f/m/d)
description:
We are looking for a Head of PMO to lead the project management organisation of our machinery division.

What you'll do
- Lead a team of 10 project managers and coordinators
- Define the project management methodology and governance
- Report portfolio status and risks to the executive board

What you bring
- 15+ years in project management in machine or plant building, 5+ in leadership
- Strong portfolio and resource-management skills
- Fluent English
